notes.title: The Other Me Update v0.2
notes.content:
It has been 6 days since the launch, and during this time, we have received both positive and negative feedback. We would like to thank all the players who wanted to play, played, and shared their evaluations! ♥ Reaching more people every day excites us. We hope to achieve our goals on the path we have planned and provide a satisfying experience for players. So far, we have fixed many issues in the game, added new content, and improved existing features. From now on, we will continue to carefully read and evaluate even the smallest feedback.

Quest and Story Improvements
[list]
[*] The issue of the creature getting stuck at the door and preventing quest progress has been fixed with different triggers.
[*] Some quest descriptions have been made more understandable.
[*] Missing subtitles have been fixed, and overlapping subtitles have been resolved.
[*] The bald NPC in the first house has been temporarily removed, and new alternatives have been added to the house.
[*] Cutscenes have been made smoother and adjusted.
[*] The number of NPCs has been balanced.
[/list]

Gameplay Improvements
[list]
[*] The loot system has been made more balanced and user-friendly.
[*] The interaction areas of AI NPCs have been expanded, and their numbers adjusted.
[*] AI NPCs now operate more stably and functionally.
[*] Signboards have been added to address various navigation issues.
[*] Collision issues that reduced gameplay quality have been resolved.
[*] Areas with frequent stuttering have been optimized.
[*] The duration of informational messages has been extended.
[*] The loot system has been rebalanced.
[/list]

Technical Fixes and Optimization
[list]
[*] Bugs preventing the achievement of certain accomplishments have been fixed.
[*] Many small invisible issues have been resolved.
[*] Situations causing various errors have been fixed.
[*] Optimization improvements have been implemented.
[*] Areas with insufficient lighting have been adjusted.
[*] Balancing and general improvements have been made.
[*] Overall game quality has been enhanced.
[/list]

Language and Translation Updates
[list]
[*] Issues where selected language packs were inactive have been fixed.
[*] Missing language packs have been completed.
[*] Errors in website translations have been corrected.
[*] Reported language errors have been fixed.
[/list]

Website Updates
[list]
[*] The mobile version of the website is now fully functional.
[*] Missing translations in the English language option on the website have been added.
[/list]

notes.title: The Other Me Devlog #07
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/763626998ed373a9a35ff60d32f14600d90e092d.png[/img]

It's been a long time since we released the demo, and we carefully evaluated the feedback we received both from the demo and about our game. Based on this feedback, we made extensive improvements to the main game. The experiences we gained during and before the demo process have taught us valuable lessons in the development of the game. Today, we can proudly say that the game is at a completely different level compared to its initial state.

To summarize the key points: we aim to provide a much more immersive and fluid gaming experience with story-based changes, deepened content, gameplay and user interface improvements, new mechanics, and performance optimizations. We promise our players a richer world, more dynamic gameplay, and flawless technical performance.

For those who want more detailed information, we have listed everything below.

On the UI side, we now offer a much more user-friendly structure. In-game menus have been simplified and redesigned with a minimalist approach. We removed many settings that caused unnecessary time loss for users; we realized that most of them were unnecessary. As for the HUD, in-game directions and story presentations have been made more effective. We also added tips and pop-up notifications to make the gameplay experience smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/e1b12a5d04b38c15b6ee0e693db32db58fc73e91.png[/img] On the story side, we made significant additions without straying from the main theme. We enriched our world with new creatures, characters, and their stories. With these changes, we aim to create more confusion in the game, and we believe this will make the players enjoy it even more. Additionally, we improved the overall aesthetic of the game by fixing simple and disjointed elements. Regarding translations, we corrected missing languages and mistranslated sentences, providing a more seamless experience for the global player base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/8d8c277f921fee0079c242cb50757df0b40b2b28.png[/img] To create a more cinematic atmosphere, we revamped the environment and vegetation. This made the game's world more aligned with the theme and provided a more fluid gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/541dd179d014a1be9a54309cc2f64770eb73237c.png[/img] On the performance side, we made significant improvements. By making all lighting static, we achieved a considerable performance boost. We optimized LOD and HLOD settings, fixed physics-based processes and AI coding that strained the CPU, and reduced unnecessary VFX usage, replacing them with more logical and optimized options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/07ee5684dfda14f6392aebb7bd24011536690331.png[/img] We also reworked the sounds in both 2D and 3D, aiming to provide a more immersive experience. From ambient sounds to character footsteps, all sounds now work in harmony, offering a deeper atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/00866e6611e096edb26873208729d2b78dd12f27.png[/img] Cutscene transitions have also been overhauled, with scenes continuing smoothly without breaking away from the story. Moreover, it’s now possible to pause cutscenes, as we disabled the active keys in previous cutscenes to prevent accidental skipping.

As we progressed in the development process, we did our best to fix the bugs and errors we encountered. We also addressed story-based logic errors, ensuring a more consistent experience. The frequently encountered quest system issues during the demo were resolved as well. Quests are now linked in a chain and update at each stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/593578dad93507966a8054ba70768a37682057c2.png[/img] We noticed that Post Process settings caused millisecond delays. As playability is just as important to us as visual appeal, we optimized the Post Process settings to provide a smoother experience. Speaking of performance, we should also mention the game's file size. As we continue to learn new things with the development of Unreal Engine 5, we have significantly reduced the game's file size. We cleaned up everything that caused file bloat, such as unnecessary collision data, unused items, and meshes we forgot during testing. We also updated and optimized existing assets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/323c021f97ee5af6025987db5573a84ac1a1ff89.png[/img] As we tried different things, we occasionally experienced system malfunctions, which led to flickering issues on the screen. Fortunately, we resolved this problem, providing a more stable and error-free visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/8f00a9ec178343d671baa6d0453d5abd195983ed.png[/img] We also fixed echo issues in areas with 3D sound. Now, sounds will reverberate more realistically and logically according to physical barriers, creating a more immersive ambiance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/ffe8bae98d4a6a8e1cdd60d9cb0f0b639427dfb8.png[/img] We also integrated the Save system, which was one of the most mentioned issues in feedback and something we seriously felt the lack of during the demo. This system will work in full harmony with the game. Since we didn’t want to force players to use a menu that would disrupt their focus during the game, we developed a different solution. We hope you like this new approach!

notes.title: A Thank You Letter
notes.content:
Your interest in The Other Me Demo, which we released at Steam Next Fest February 2024, was above our expectations. We can't thank you enough. Your feedback during this period, both about the demo and the future of the main game, has been very helpful in shaping how we will proceed in the future.

This is more than just an in-game patch note, your guidance has strengthened our optimization, voice acting and subtitles, gameplay, graphics and storytelling. We now have much more detailed and big ideas for the main game, and we will continue to develop the game with a more unique and immersive approach. 

We will continue to release patch notes on the game's development. We will also make sure to share visual details to make the patch notes more pleasing to the eye.

Thank you again for your interest in this short period of time, during which we have seen over four hundred thousand interactions. 

We hope to see you soon with more quality content!

notes.title: The Other Me Demo Update 0.2
notes.content:
This patch only affects the Demo version of The Other Me.

Reduced object density and removed unnecessary items.
Map lighting has been changed to improve visibility.
Objects that can be picked up and interacted with have been made more prominent.
Changes and corrections to cutscenes.
Added new story-related subtitles.
Added info widget to reduce confusion.
Reconfigured background sounds.
Performance improvements have been made.
Reorganized objects that block and allow passage in some areas.
Removed and fixed buggy items by climbing on them.
Missing translations have been completed.
With this patch, dozens of gameplay-impacting, performance-impairing minor fixes and more have been made.

notes.title: The Other Me Demo is now available!
notes.content:
This patch note applies to the demo version only.

For a smoother gaming experience, we recommend staying at the recommended graphics settings or keeping the screen scaling between 50% and 100%.

Tasks have been updated for clarity.
The guiding effect of the quests has been edited and new ones have been added to replace missing ones.
New more descriptive subtitles have been added along with the missions.
Fixed missing colisions and fixed interaction with items.
Fixed missing sound effects and added new ambience and sound effects, as well as fixing overlapping sounds that were already present.
Fixed missing translations.
Extended the duration of subtitles that did not have enough time to read.
Fixed right and left lean angles during gameplay and made them more realistic.
Fixed an issue where skins were not visible on models.
Fixed extra performance loss in the attic and basement.
Lightened extremely dark areas.
Fixed broken and non-loading cutscenes.
Changed rain dynamics to make them more realistic.
Fixed the bug of re-entering the game after the chapter ends.
Fixed the bug of replaying footsteps.
Fixed typos and writings on in-game papers according to screen optimization.

Along with these, there may be patches that we forgot to mention, we continue to receive feedback on the demo. Your comments and suggestions are very important to us. You can reach us via our website, Discord or e-mail addresses.

This patch requires a re-download of the demo. We are working on a patching system to prevent repeated downloads.

notes.title: The Other Me Devlog #06
notes.content:
We are almost done working on the Prologue, the demo version of The Other Me, which will be released on Steam Next Fest February 2024. Updates and details about the Prologue are as follows.

Prologue

The story narration in the Prologue is dubbed in Turkish and English.
Story subtitles have been localized for all languages specified at launch.
Potential bugs have been fixed and are all in testing.
All cutscenes and opening scenes in the Prologue have been edited.
Fixed possible animation bugs.
Created a deeper atmosphere with background sounds to increase the sense of reality.
The entire UI/UI has been changed down to the last detail to blend in with the theme of the game.
This has resulted in a simpler and more intuitive UI.
3D Sounds have been adjusted for location and physical obstacles, and echo errors have been fixed.
Standby screens have been enhanced with small in-game and story-oriented information.

General

General performance and optimization work has been done.
Fixed light and shadow bugs.

notes.title: The Other Me Devlog #05
notes.content:

We've started work on our Prologue episode, which will be available to players as a pre-release or demo at Steam Next Fest February 2024. The Prologue episode design has been designed to fit the story as planned, making the main scenes and cutscenes more immersive.
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/c0f48304df8a4118be4e3c93ff3b20ec25bd1e61.png[/img]

All locations, from small gardens to large buildings, and every item that can be interacted with in the game have had a better quality sound effect added or edited, as well as integrating real-life sound models with new items.

In terms of the interface, all menus, including in-game, support all languages as mentioned above, and we tried to be sensitive to include only the necessary information that would not strain the eyes in terms of ease of use. The in-game interface has also been minimized to give the feeling of progressing as a whole with the game.

We have made corrections to the in-game design and physics basics, including resizing objects, upgrading the quality of the skins and downgrading them when necessary to reduce the overall performance and file size of the game, adding new complementary skins, and many other skin optimizations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/17f711771c30402af06b5dc458ba0717f2f12dbe.png[/img]
 
The lighting has been changed to a more foggy and hazy scheme to reflect the dark mood of the game. We fixed buggy lighting mechanics, removed conflicting lights or reduced their lumens, as well as performance improvements in this section.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443869/d725f0da09f9e9b49b5b287dead5bcfc6849f7c8.png[/img]

AI-assisted bug and bug fixes on Unreal Engine 5, as there are details that can be missed by the human eye... We made general presets testing and performance improvements more functional and removed unnecessary collision and redundant coding.  We fixed and fixed mechanical tests and the resulting bugs.

AI-supported interface, subtitle and update data is now available in Turkish, English, French, Italian, German, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Czech, Ukrainian.

notes.title: Thank You ♥
notes.content:
We've been developing The Other Me since June 2023 and we've been working on the game non-stop until today, so we gave ourselves a 2 week vacation break.

At the end of this 5 month period we surpassed 10,000+ views, which was a huge achievement for us and we are very happy to have unlocked it. ♥

We have decided to share DevLOGs on a monthly basis instead of weekly. This will help us to eliminate unnecessary repetitive details and provide you with more important updates in a better quality way. In the new update layout, we have decided to classify each change/development/update in its own category for a more streamlined interface.

New and higher quality sounds have been integrated into objects and environments.
Overlapping reflections in ambient lighting have been fixed one by one.
Created cutscenes for transitions between scenes.
New animations for characters and objects.
Fixed missing and misplaced objects in the map design.
VFX have been added.
All languages supported on the Steam page have been integrated into the game as needed.
Reduced the file size of the game.
General bugfix and optimization.
